Container.Name: theater-panel
Container.Overview: Home theater wall panel: Plex browse and play, Seerr requests, Music Assistant, lights, projector and games, served to Kiosk Satellite. Talks to Home Assistant over its websocket; everything it controls goes through HA.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The panel. The k3s route for ht-kiosk.coulson.io points at this port on the Unraid host (10.2.3.4).

Config.Name: Data (image cache)
Config.Description: Poster and artwork cache.

Config.Name: Config (games.json)
Config.Description: Holds games.json (HDMI switcher, consoles, gaming PC).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Turns on the settings page at /admin (everything below can then be changed there without editing the container).

Config.Name: Home Assistant token
Config.Description: Long-lived access token (HA profile > Security).

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: X-Plex-Token of the server owner.

Config.Name: Plex libraries
Config.Description: Library tabs, in order, comma-separated. Empty shows every movie and TV library.

Config.Name: Seerr API key
Config.Description: Seerr > Settings > General > API Key.

Config.Name: Frame ancestors
Config.Description: Origins allowed to embed the panel (the Home Assistant dashboard Kiosk Satellite shows), space- or comma-separated.

Config.Name: Projector entity
Config.Description: Android Debug Bridge media_player for the NexiGo.

Config.Name: Projector apps
Config.Description: Apps on the Projector card, as Name=package pairs (comma-separated). They open on the projector over ADB.

Config.Name: Music players
Config.Description: Music Assistant players under Play on; the first is the theater's own.

Config.Name: Plex player entity
Config.Description: HA's media_player for the Plex client that Play targets.

Config.Name: Plex player name
Config.Description: That client's name as Plex reports it, to pick the theater's session. Empty uses the first playing session.

Config.Name: Steam API key
Config.Description: For the Steam library on the Games screen.

Config.Name: Steam ID
Config.Description: 64-bit SteamID.

Config.Name: Seerr user id
Config.Description: Make requests as this Seerr user instead of the API key's owner.

Config.Name: Seerr region
Config.Description: Region for streaming-service lookups.

Config.Name: Panel key
Config.Description: Optional shared key; clients open the panel once with ?key=... and keep a cookie.

Config.Name: Quality badges
Config.Description: 4K / HDR / Dolby Vision labels on posters.

Config.Name: Network badges
Config.Description: Streaming network labels on posters.

Config.Name: Cache directory
Config.Description: Inside the container; keep it under /data.
